high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "gabriellademetriades," taken 9 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The post shows a photograph of a grand, historic building with classical architectural features. The building appears to be made of light-colored stone or concrete, with multiple windows arranged symmetrically across its facade. The windows have a traditional design, with some featuring arched tops. The entrance of the building is centrally located and framed by large columns, leading up to a set of steps.
